digest.component_or_area: reconciler backend assembly and port validation
propositions: JiraDataCenterBackend does not satisfy the Backend @runtime_checkable protocol because it lacks query_project and assert_env_ready members, despite being registered and reachable via select_backend factory
reconciler.backend configuration option rejects 'jira-datacenter' even though the backend is registered, making the DC backend unreachable through config

DC inbound identity minting for assignees lacking accountId fails silently because the guard demands an identifier DC never supplies, and fixing the guard alone introduces a swallowed ValueError on unmapped creation_channel

the TicketTransport protocol declares only six methods but the core calls set_entity_property from three sites, making protocol conformance insufficient to prevent runtime AttributeError on writing passes
FakeTransport used in contract suite tests lacks probe_remote delegation that the DC backend delegates to, creating an untested code path
a live writing pass against real Jira DC crashes with missing set_entity_property, while dry-run passes succeed, indicating incomplete port specification
